what_it_does: Tiny flying robots (microrobots under 2 grams) need to drive their mechanical actuators (electrostatic or piezoelectric devices that move parts) using high voltage while running on minimal battery power to stay airborne. This paper presents a compact, lightweight power conversion system that uses a novel flying solid-state battery to step up voltage from low-voltage sources (3-5V) to the tens of volts needed by the actuators, while efficiently managing reactive energy (power stored and returned by capacitive loads) to extend flight time.
